shows.title: Munawwara Ka Khadim
shows.plot_overview: Munawwara Ka Khadim is an upcoming Pakistani television drama series on HUM TV that stars the popular on-screen reunion of Hamza Sohail and Sehar Khan.

shows.title: Unskilled Adult
shows.plot_overview: After years of successfully mucking around for a living, Hamish Blake has realised when it comes to practical skills, he doesn’t have many. To remedy this, Hamish starts a business helping real people with jobs they really need done, for real money and putting himself firmly on the hook.

shows.title: ONE N' ONLYのフルアウトTV
shows.plot_overview: ONE N' ONLY’s first regular variety show, forcing all five members through grueling physical trials and skill-building workshops. Guided by demanding "Full-out Teachers," the group commits 100% total effort, embracing body-stunts, hilarious failure, and intense unscripted challenges without hesitation.

shows.title: Fifty Shades Freed
shows.plot_overview: Believing they have left behind shadowy figures from their past, newlyweds Christian and Ana fully embrace an inextricable connection and shared life of luxury. But just as she steps into her role as Mrs. Grey and he relaxes into an unfamiliar stability, new threats could jeopardize their happy ending before it even begins.

shows.title: Stress Test
shows.plot_overview: Join Rodrigo, the self-proclaimed “most stressed out person in the world,” as he seeks out different remedies, from the conventional to the fringes of science, on his quest to tackle life’s many stresses.

shows.title: Cartoonified! With Kiff
shows.plot_overview: In Cartoonified, your favorite celebrities become cartoons in each new episode!

shows.title: Cruella
shows.plot_overview: In 1970s London amidst the punk rock revolution, a young grifter named Estella is determined to make a name for herself with her designs. She befriends a pair of young thieves who appreciate her appetite for mischief, and together they are able to build a life for themselves on the London streets. One day, Estella’s flair for fashion catches the eye of the Baroness von Hellman, a fashion legend who is devastatingly chic and terrifyingly haute.
